_comment: Ported from SIGNS in Parlour v23.dc.html (line ~1201). {S}/{s}/{is}/{es}/{p}/{do}/{o}/{r} are pronoun tokens filled from a sitter's pronoun (he/she/they) at display time — see PRON in the source.

signs.rule: {S} {is} already ahead of you. The first card of every reading restores nothing.
{S} need{es} it to be a performance. A reading of fewer than three cards restores nothing at all.
{S} interrupt{es} with a story of {p} own. Whatever you speak last restores half.
Nothing reaches {o} cold. A wall holds off the first points of every reading — what it holds off wears the wall away, but it thickens 3 again after every one.
{S} correct{es} you back into shape. A sign already spoken in this reading restores nothing the second time.
{S} {do} not believe anything happens tonight. Fire restores nothing at {p} table.
{S} will not sit still. One card leaves your hand at random before every reading.
{S} weigh{es} both sides of everything. Cards of {p} own sign restore half.
{S} {is} already somewhere else. You have one less energy every reading.
{S} take{es} it back inside. Whatever your best card restores is halved.
{S} know{es} what you are. No card pays its condition — nothing for opening, closing or following.
{S} cannot hold it. Nothing is held off the first reading, and the wall thickens 4 after every one.
